productionBlockers.finding: Seven of nine shared Garage cost factors disagree with printed authority. Source certificate specifies correct factor; code/transaction parity unverified.
Existing raw appendage definitions mark unarmed attack unavailable despite source size/damage rows.
Credit Reader overlay has effect but no raw priced definition: 50 credits/1kg Licensed is canonical source price; current default quote risks zero.
Full runtime coverage of armor proficiency penalties, nonstacking, heavy run and Crystadurium/Duravlex special defenses not tested.
Factory-granted vocabulator for non-Binary-capable droids must not be charged again in PC chargen.
DC/time/permission and self-modify exceptions are printed; no end-to-end Garage/chargen Store integration tests executed.

guardrails: Full source-mechanical certificate validates what published rules require, not what current code correctly does
Cannot award runtime compliance without integration and Foundry verification
No source-invented slots, no additional attacks from appendages, no unconditional special defense triggers
Source-defined zero/silent fields not equivalent to zero-weight or zero-price
Apply Core p197 maintenance/installation DC, time, skill and self-work exceptions
Canonical ledger is system.installedSystems after creation, with external objects excluded
No compendium, actor, runtime code, Garage, Store or chargen modified
